criterion: Produces a design document under docs/plans/ (or complete design specification in the response) while leaving ledgerbus/ source files untouched.
References ledgerbus/service.py (LedgerService, LedgerEntry, EventSink) and explains the dual-write failure mode between state mutation and event publication.
Compares at least two candidate designs (such as synchronous transactional outbox buffer with explicit flush vs change-log cursor tailing vs two-phase callback) and states their trade-offs.
Specifies how monotonic sequence numbers or event IDs preserve per-account ordering and allow downstream consumers to deduplicate replayed messages.
Defines test scenarios verifying atomic rollback on state validation error, retry of pending outbox entries after transient sink failure, and duplicate suppression.
